best_for: Students who want to build their own websites
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: No prerequisites. A great first step into typing code.

prerequisites.recommended: An eye for colors and design.

system_requirements.software_accounts: Modern web browser, Glitch account, Canva account.

overview.positioning: A creative, fast-paced introduction to building beautiful things on the internet.
overview.short_description: Become a web designer! Learn how to use HTML to build pages, CSS to make them colorful, and Canva to design awesome logos for your very own websites.

key_facts.capstone: Build and Publish a Live Personal Website

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Write standard HTML to structure a web page
Use CSS to add colors, fonts, and layouts
Design simple graphics and logos using Canva
Publish a website live on the internet using Glitch

why_now.industry_shift: Every business, project, and idea needs a website.
why_now.ai_impact: Understanding the underlying code of the web helps kids use web-building tools better.
why_now.business_demand: Web design is a highly accessible entry point to tech careers.
why_now.career_opportunity: Combines artistic creativity with technical coding skills.

learning_outcomes: STRUCTURE: Build the skeleton of a website using HTML tags.
STYLE: Paint the website using CSS properties.
DESIGN: Create complementary graphics for the web.
PUBLISH: Deploy a project so anyone in the world can see it.

stages.name: Code
stages.desc: Writing HTML and CSS on Glitch.

stages.name: Publish
stages.desc: Getting a live link to share.

best_practices:
Close your HTML tags immediately after opening them (e.g.,

).
Keep your CSS organized and easy to read.
Make sure your text colors contrast well with your backgrounds.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Typo in the file path or image link.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Always double-check the exact spelling of image files.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Forgetting to link the CSS file to the HTML file.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Check the <head> section for the <link> tag.

career_paths.employer_expectations: Ability to structure and style simple web pages.

freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: Link to their live Glitch website.

what_you_will_build: A personal portfolio or hobby website
final_deliverables: A live, published multi-page website featuring custom graphics.

assessment.criteria: Website is live, features working links, images, and custom CSS styling.

faq.question: Will the website be actually on the internet?
faq.answer: Yes! By using Glitch, the students will get a real link they can send to family and friends.

faq.question: Do they need design experience?
faq.answer: No, we will teach them basic color theory and how to use Canva to make things look great easily.

modules.module_purpose: Learn how to structure text and media on a webpage.
what_you_will_learn: Setting up a project in Glitch

lessons.what_is_taught: How the internet works, HTML tags.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates their first Glitch project and types a heading.
Builds a digital recipe card with ingredients and steps.
lessons.expected_outcome: A structured text document on the web.

lessons.why_it_matters: Makes the web visual and connected.
lessons.what_learner_does: Adds a photo of their favorite food and links to a recipe site.

modules.hands_on_practice: Build a 'Top 5' list page (e.g., Top 5 Movies) with images and links.
modules.assignment: Submit the Glitch link to the Top 5 page.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to write basic HTML documents.

modules.module_title: Painting the Canvas: CSS and Design
modules.module_purpose: Learn how to make the webpage look beautiful and professional.
what_you_will_learn: Using CSS to change colors and fonts
Using Canva to make a logo

lessons.what_is_taught: CSS syntax, colors, backgrounds, and fonts.
lessons.why_it_matters: Turns boring text into a designed experience.
lessons.what_learner_does: Links a CSS file and changes the background color and font of their page.

lessons.why_it_matters: Makes the page look neat and organized.
lessons.what_learner_does: Creates framed images and neat text boxes.

lessons.why_it_matters: Custom graphics make a site unique.
lessons.what_learner_does: Designs a personal logo in Canva and adds it to their website.

modules.hands_on_practice: Design and build a complete personal homepage about a hobby.
modules.assignment: Submit the final live Glitch URL for the personal website.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to design, style, and publish a complete basic website.
